body: I step out of the train, squinting against the bright sunlight as the early morning rush hits the station. The air is thick with the smell of damp earth and the distant tang of coffee. My eyes scan the area, taking in the bustling station. I notice a few people moving around, their faces blurred in the morning light. I feel a surge of heat in my cheeks as I realize I'm not the only one who feels this way. My mind is racing with what to do next.
